title: Custom Compound Plating Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the fields provided above the protocol.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required labware definition files (JSON extensions).

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the protocol script file (PY extension).

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing tip racks, source plates, and destination plates in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, the tip rack, and the pipette using the calibration workflow in the Opentrons App; consult support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run”. The same tip will be used for each source, and the system will prompt you to refill the deck when all destination plates have been processed.
